question:
How many hands are hairs?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f7f353e0053848bcc9090fd2651556d636d12c788f0fb42862448d3cfac157dc.png]
solution:
According to the given Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8999168e6b7a3d17b6eaac05af52cc0aa6fa954b469e7ee0a8f94aded183130b.png] 

The shaded area shows the "total number of hands are hairs".

So, the total number of 'hands are hairs' = 4 + 2 = 6.

Hence, the correct answer
